{"schema_json":{"type":"object","properties":{"expense":{"type":"string"},"cost":{"type":"number"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["Food","Shopping","Transportation"]},"date":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["expense","cost","category","date"]},"cookbook_content":"# Enhanced expense log
This log helps track your expenses with categories to better understand your spending habits.

## Fields:
- **expense**: Description of the expense (e.g., Starbucks coffee).
- **cost**: Amount spent (e.g., 5.25).
- **category**: Type of expense (e.g., Food, Shopping, Transportation).
- **date**: Date of the expense in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

## Sample Messages:
- Starbucks coffee $5.25 on 2023-10-01
- Whole Foods groceries $134.56 on 2023-10-01

## Sample Current Interpretations:
- Message: "Starbucks coffee $5.25 on 2023-10-01"
  - Interpretation: {"expense": "Starbucks coffee", "cost": 5.25, "category": "Food", "date": "2023-10-01"}
- Message: "Whole Foods groceries $134.56 on 2023-10-01"
  - Interpretation: {"expense": "Whole Foods groceries", "cost": 134.56, "category": "Food", "date": "2023-10-01"}"}
